capabilities: Typeset notes into paginated book pages in a live preview pane
Export print-ready tagged PDF with crop marks, bleed, and page labels
Export reflowable EPUB 3 with themes, cover, and landmarks
Convert Japanese notation such as ruby, emphasis dots, and tate-chu-yoko
Assemble books from a folder, a table-of-contents note, or wikilinks
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile build; it prints through Obsidian's Chromium). The bundled themes are Vivliostyle Themes v2; v3 themes are silently ignored. The full user manual and sample setup guides are in Japanese. The preview cannot resolve contents-page numbers until every page is laid out unless 'Render every page up front' is enabled.
problem: Obsidian's own PDF export cannot produce paged book layouts, vertical Japanese writing, ruby, crop marks, bleeds, or EPUB output.

relations.evidence: the typesetting engine ships in the plugin
Code Space is a useful community plugin; it is also what the author of this README uses.

summary: Typesets notes into paginated books with Vivliostyle and exports print-ready PDF or EPUB 3, with a live page preview supporting Japanese vertical writing.
